title: Contract-tests record
description: The outcome of the contract tests at one commit: a map from a repository-relative test path, optionally followed by `::<name>`, to pass, fail or skip. Produced by `gate tests-record`, read by `skeleton check --tests-record`. An empty results map means nothing ran. The key shape (a relative path, then an optional non-empty `::name`) is a semantic check in batuta_lib/contract.py.

commit.description: The commit the tests ran at: 7 to 40 lowercase hex digits.

generated.description: The date the record was produced, YYYY-MM-DD.

results.description: Key: a POSIX relative test path, optionally `::<name>` (no leading slash or ./, no backslash, drive letter or .. segment). Value: pass, fail or skip.
